# Preprocessing log (generated by run.py)

| step | what | why | affected |
|---|---|---|---|
| A2 duplicates | EDFA: drop exact duplicate rows (same id, timestamp, value) | pure repeats; one unmapped SFP id arrives 5x per poll | 521 rows |
| A2 join | SFP: keep unmapped sensor ids as UNMAPPED_<id8> | the brief left them in deliberately; dropping them would silently lose data | 1,775,993 readings, 60 ids |
| A2 duplicates | SFP: drop exact duplicate rows (same id, timestamp, value) | pure repeats; one unmapped SFP id arrives 5x per poll | 130,051 rows |
| A4 pivot | EDFA: align readings to 1-min slots; keep the last non-blank reading per sensor and slot | sensor groups are polled seconds apart within each minute; the uptime counter is polled twice a minute | 99,027 readings merged (47,879 slots had differing values) |
| A4 pivot | SFP: align readings to 1-min slots; keep the last non-blank reading per sensor and slot | sensor groups are polled seconds apart within each minute; the uptime counter is polled twice a minute | 29,487 readings merged (1,241 slots had differing values) |
| B3 sentinels/validity | EDFA: mask readings outside physical envelope | impossible for a working device (sentinel, glitch or corrupted value); logged as point anomalies for Part D | 4 readings in 3 sensors |
| B3 sentinels/validity | SFP: mask readings outside physical envelope | impossible for a working device (sentinel, glitch or corrupted value); logged as point anomalies for Part D | 30,859 readings in 19 sensors |
| B2 outages | EDFA: mask optical readings while ICMP loss = 100% (+5 min guard) | unreachable device: optical values missing or stale; must not train or score on them | 51,331 asset-minutes; 3,978 readings masked |
| B2 outages | SFP: mask optical readings while ICMP loss = 100% (+5 min guard) | unreachable device: optical values missing or stale; must not train or score on them | 2,982 asset-minutes; 196 readings masked |
| B1 resample | EDFA: 5-min median bins from first optical reading | keeps minute-scale fibre events visible, removes single-poll noise; 3-4 readings per bin | 25,086 bins over 2 assets |
| B2 gaps | fill polling misses <= 2 bins by time interpolation; never fill outages or longer gaps | slow physical quantities; longer gaps would invent data | 3,580 EDFA values filled |
| B1 resample | SFP: 15-min median bins aligned to the module's 15-min windows | slower failure modes; matches device aggregation | 8,509 bins |
| B4 SFP window | use the Current window for Bias/Temp/Voltage/Tx/Rx; keep day windows only as a cross-check | Current: 0% impossible values and poll-aligned; Current Day up to 24% impossible; Previous 15min clock 49-94 min ahead with constant bias offsets | 10 of 40 window x metric x port series kept as features |
| B3 junk | exclude Pump2 * (both units single-pump), Uptime (hardware) (constant 0), SFP 'Current: Timestamp' (constant-0 sentinel) | not physical measurements; the zero timestamp is a sentinel, the other windows' timestamps are real epochs | 8 + 2 EDFA columns, 2 SFP columns |
| B5 features | EDFA: keep 14 of 42 asset-sensor columns | physical telemetry tied to the failure modes; every drop has a one-line reason in feature_decisions | 28 dropped |
| B5 features | SFP: keep 11 of 150 asset-sensor columns | physical telemetry tied to the failure modes; every drop has a one-line reason in feature_decisions | 139 dropped |
| B6 scaling | per-asset scaling; residuals in physical units scaled by training-period MAD floored at sensor resolution | two EDFA operating classes (15 vs 7 dBm); quantised sensors would otherwise give zero spread | all model inputs |
